newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-TOP WELSH CLUBS AGREE TO WORK WITH RUGBY UNION.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TOP WELSH CLUBS AGREE TO WORK WITH RUGBY UNION.

text.p: The top 12 Welsh rugby clubs have agreed to continue working with the Welsh Rugby Football Union (WRFU) after threatening to emulate their English counterparts and break away from their ruling body.
After a three-hour meeting on Wednesday night, club delegates acknowledged they could control their competitions and organise sponsorship while remaining members of the WRFU.

"There was a frank exchange of views concerning the heavy demands of running professional rugby in Wales and the means by which first division clubs, as businesses, and the governing body can best meet these new demands," a joint statement from the WRFU and the clubs said.

On Wednesday England's international squad boycotted the first training session of the new season and allied themselves with breakaway clubs who intend to declare independence from the Rugby Football Union next month.
